## Which download do I need?

Every download comes in English and in Spanish. The language is in the file name, right after the version: `-EN-` is
English and `-ES-` is Spanish.

### English

| Your device                                   | Download                                                                                                              |
| --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows (most players)                        | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-EN-Windows-x64-Setup.exe`: installs for your user account, no admin rights needed            |
| Windows (every user on the PC, or IT-managed) | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-EN-Windows-x64-AllUsers.msi`: installs for all users under Program Files, needs admin rights |
| Mac with an Apple chip (M1 or later)          | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-EN-macOS-AppleSilicon-arm64.dmg`                                                             |
| Mac with an Intel processor                   | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-EN-macOS-Intel-x64.dmg`                                                                      |
| Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!_OS          | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-EN-Linux-x64.deb`                                                                            |
| Linux: Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE                 | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-EN-Linux-x64.rpm`                                                                            |
| Linux: any other distro                       | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-EN-Linux-x64.AppImage`                                                                       |
| Android phone or tablet                       | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-EN-Android.apk`                                                                              |

### Español (Spanish)

Cartas en español: the same downloads with `-ES-` in place of `-EN-`. They show the Spanish card scans, and the English
scan for any card that has no Spanish one yet. Installing one replaces the English app, and your saves carry over.

| Your device                                   | Download                                                  |
| --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows (most players)                        | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-ES-Windows-x64-Setup.exe`        |
| Windows (every user on the PC, or IT-managed) | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-ES-Windows-x64-AllUsers.msi`     |
| Mac with an Apple chip (M1 or later)          | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-ES-macOS-AppleSilicon-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with an Intel processor                   | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-ES-macOS-Intel-x64.dmg`          |
| Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!_OS          | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-ES-Linux-x64.deb`                |
| Linux: Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE                 | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-ES-Linux-x64.rpm`                |
| Linux: any other distro                       | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-ES-Linux-x64.AppImage`           |
| Android phone or tablet                       | `MarvelChampions-VERSION-ES-Android.apk`                  |

To play from Steam (library art, Big Picture, Steam Deck): run your system's `MarvelChampions-VERSION-*-Install-for-Steam`
script after installing the game (on Windows, double-click the `.cmd`). [How](https://github.com/quincarter/marvel-champions-digital-game/blob/main/docs/project/downloads.md#play-it-from-steam).
Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu → About This Mac: "Chip" means Apple chip, "Processor" means Intel.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum. The `.app.tar.gz` files are the bare macOS apps; most players want the `.dmg`.

Chat about the game on the [community Discord](https://discord.gg/tCy5tqu46j). Found a bug or have an idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/quincarter/marvel-champions-digital-game/issues/new/choose).
